title: Asks for a fee before you get something
why: Genuine winnings, jobs, parcels and loans do not need you to pay first. The fee is the scam.
examples: Pay Rs 4,500 as customs fee to release your gift parcel.
Transfer Rs 2,000 to release your prize amount today.
safe: Pay the exam registration fee at the college counter before 5 pm.
Your parcel was delivered. No further payment is due.
